    {"id": "ALL", "field": "Polymer system Notes", "value": "PEO and lithium salts (LiI, LiClO4, and LiCF3SO3) based composite polymer electrolytes have been prepared for different [EO]/[Li] ratio using solution casting method and characterized by x-ray diffraction (XRD-), scanning electron microscope, and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC-). The electrical measurements have been carried out at different temperatures."},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "Polymer family", "value": "ether"},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "chain architecture", "value": "linear"},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "Solvent used", "value": "acetonitrile"},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "drying temp", "value": "60 °C"},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "drying time (h)", "value": "36 h"},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "drying vacuum", "value": "yes"},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "Notes", "value": "PEO (MW= 400 000, Aldrich- and appropriate amount of vacuum dried anhydrous LiI/LiClO4/LiCF3SO3 (Aldrich- were dissolved in acetonitrile under stirring condition. After stirring for 8–10 h at room temperature, the solutions became very thick due to solvent evaporation. Finally, they were cast in PTFE containers and dried in vacuum (at a pressure 0.01 mbar- at 60 °C for 36 h to form the homogeneous free standing films. Good free standing films were obtained for [EO] / [Li] = 9, 12, 15, and 18."},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "DOI", "value": "10.1063/1.3428389"},
    {"id": "ALL", "field": "Reference", "value": "Journal of Applied Physics 107, 104113 (2010); doi: 10.1063/1.3428389"}
  ]
}
